rules.name: Chest pain / squeezing pain in the anterior region
rules.advice: Please call 120 immediately or go to the nearest emergency department of the hospital. Do not drive by yourself and do not wait for observation.
keywords: Pain in the anterior region of the heart
Pain in the front of the heart
My chest is pressed and I panic.
When my mother got up this morning, she said that she had a chest pain and was sweating.
Recently, my chest is always tight, and I'm short of breath when I take two steps.
His heart ached so much that he was sweating and his face turned pale.
My chest is stuffy these days, especially when I lie down at night.
My father's anterior chest pain is the kind of squeezing pain.

rules.name: Severe shortness of breath
rules.advice: Please call 120 immediately, stay in a sitting or semi-lying position, untie your collar, and do not lie flat.
keywords: I can't breathe after climbing two floors. I have to rest for a while.
I suddenly woke up in the middle of the night and couldn't breathe.
I always feel that it is hard to breathe, and I feel short of breath when I walk a few steps.

rules.name: DISORDER OF CONSCIOUSNESS / FAINTING / CONVULSIONS
rules.advice: Please call 120 immediately and let the patient lie on his side. Do not force your limbs and do not stuff anything into your mouth.
keywords: The old man suddenly fainted, and he didn't respond.
He suddenly fainted and his face turned blue.
Friends are confused and can't answer questions clearly.

rules.name: Massive haemorrhage
rules.advice: Please call 120 immediately and continue to press the bleeding area with a clean dressing. Do not release it repeatedly.
keywords: He has been coughing up blood, and the amount is quite high.
Spit out a pool of blood, which looks like a lot of bleeding.
The nose is bleeding non-stop, and I can't stop the cotton stuffing.

rules.name: Suspected stroke
rules.advice: Please call 120 immediately to record the specific time when the symptoms appear. Do not feed the patient with water and medicine.
keywords: Half of the body is weak
The corners of the mouth are crooked
Half of my body can't move.
Half of the body is weak.
Half of the body is numb.
My father can't move half of his body and can't speak clearly.
When I got up in the morning, my mouth was crooked and my eyes were slanted, and one side of my limbs was weak.

rules.name: Severe abdominal pain accompanied by abdominal tension
rules.advice: Please go to the emergency department immediately. Don't take painkillers by yourself and don't eat or drink water.
keywords: My stomach hurts so much that I keep vomiting.
The abdominal pain is severe, and the stomach is hard to touch.

rules.name: High fever convulsions in children
rules.advice: Please call 120 immediately, let the child lie on his side, loosen his collar, and do not force him to press or stuff something into his mouth.
keywords: The child had a fever and rolled his eyes up.

rules.name: Severe allergic reaction
rules.advice: Please call 120 immediately. If you have an adrenaline pen, please use it according to the instructions. Keep lying flat and raise your legs.
keywords: I have a rash all over my body and can't breathe.
After eating peanuts, my throat was so swollen that I couldn't speak.
Anaphylactic shock after taking penicillin, and I feel weak all over.

rules.name: Abdominal pain during pregnancy / vaginal bleeding
rules.advice: Please call 120 immediately or go to a hospital with an obstetric emergency room. Try to lie flat on the way and do not take medicine by yourself.
keywords: I have a stomachache after pregnancy.
I'm bleeding during pregnancy. Do I need to go to the hospital right away?
Pregnant women have abdominal pain, accompanied by a feeling of falling.

rules.name: Vomiting after head trauma / change of consciousness
rules.advice: Please go to the emergency department for evaluation as soon as possible, and stay awake and accompanied by someone on the way. If vomiting worsens or you can't wake up, call 120 immediately.
keywords: Vomit after falling to the head
I want to vomit after meeting.
I vomited after falling on my head.
I kept vomiting after falling down.
I vomited twice after falling on my head, and I was a little confused.
He vomited after hitting his head and said he had a headache.
vomited twice after falling on the head
